name: Spiteblast
description: Makes a large, loud magical explosion at your target or yourself. No damage, terrain destruction or knockback. Mischief Cipher research only.

name: Squeaky Steps
description: The recipient squeaks like a rubber toy while walking for 60 seconds. Mischief Cipher research only.

name: Unsolicited Applause
description: An imaginary audience applauds when the recipient opens a container for 60 seconds. Mischief Cipher research only.

name: Conjure Leaf
description: Drops a small illusory leaf onto the recipient's head occasionally for 60 seconds. Leaves cannot be collected. Mischief Cipher research only.

name: Suspicious Duck
description: Occasional suspicious quacking comes from behind the recipient for 60 seconds. Mischief Cipher research only.

name: Dramatic Entrance
description: Makes the recipient invisible for 10 seconds, then reveals them with lightning, thunder, smoke and a spotlight. Does not grant immunity or prevent actions. Mischief Cipher research only.

name: Hatastrophe
description: A stack of illusory wizard hats grows whenever the recipient casts a spell. Each new hat has its own brim and color. After eight growths the hats collapse into paper particles and start again. Lasts 120 seconds; no paper items are created. Mischief Cipher research only.

name: Pocket Weather
description: A tiny raincloud follows the recipient for 60 seconds and keeps them fully soaked. Wetness dries normally afterward. Mischief Cipher research only.
